ModMetaData.name: BPC Area Restriction Safety 1.5
ModMetaData.author: Allen / OpenAI
ModMetaData.description: Safety patch for RimWorld 1.5 area restrictions. Validates Better Pawn Control/other area assignments against the pawn's current map, clears stale cross-map area references, and prevents out-of-bounds Job area checks from breaking job selection. Does not patch StartJob, ThinkTree, WorkGiver, or JobGiver.
